shots.motion_prompt: Warm sunset light on a rocky cliff ledge above a green valley. A young man with curly dark hair and a beard, wearing a fur cloak, and a young woman with long dark braided hair sit very close together, facing each other. She smiles up at him and says softly in a warm, soft young woman's voice: "You keep looking at me instead of the sunset." He smiles back and answers gently in a calm, deep young man's voice: "I've seen a thousand sunsets. Only one of you." Their lips move clearly as they speak, then they hold each other's gaze in silence. A campfire crackles nearby, a soft evening wind moves their hair and the fur. The camera holds a steady medium close-up.

Warm sunset light on a rocky cliff ledge above a green valley. The young woman with long dark braided hair laughs quietly, raises her hand and touches the bearded young man's cheek, and says in a warm, soft young woman's voice: "Say that again tomorrow, when I'm muddy and tired." He keeps his eyes on hers and answers softly in a calm, deep young man's voice: "Tomorrow, and every day after." Their lips move clearly as they speak, then they smile in silence. A campfire crackles nearby, a soft evening wind moves their hair. The camera holds a steady medium close-up.

Warm sunset light on a rocky cliff ledge above a green valley. The young woman leans in close to the bearded young man and whispers in a warm, soft young woman's voice: "Then stay with me tonight." He whispers back in a calm, deep young man's voice: "Always." They close their eyes and kiss slowly and tenderly, her hand on his chest. A campfire crackles nearby, a soft evening wind moves through their hair. The camera pushes in slowly on the kiss.
